title: Cryptococcosis Associated With Bruton Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
official: Clinical Features and Outcomes of Cryptococcosis Associated With Bruton Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors: A Multicenter Retrospective Study
summary:
The purpose of this study is to describe the clinical, biological, and radiographic characteristics at the time of cryptococcosis diagnosis, as well as the time interval between the initiation of BTK inhibitor therapy and the diagnosis of cryptococcosis.

And also, the clinical course of each patient at 12 months in order to evaluate the susceptibility to cryptococcosis correlated with BTK inhibitor therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient (≥18 years old)
* Patient with a diagnosis of microbiologically documented cryptococcosis (antigen, direct examination, culture) established between January 2013 and January 2024 by the clinicians treating the patient with a BTK inhibitor (BTKi)\*.

  * Cryptococcosis diagnoses will be validated by infectious disease expert (Prof. Fanny Lanternier, Dr. Olivier Paccoud) based on information provided by the clinicians treating the patient.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient objecting to the use of their data.
* Patient under legal guardianship or curatorship.
* Patient unable to provide free and informed consent.
